name: Shikarpur

queries.query: Shikarpur Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Sindh
queries.result: First-party Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh land-record portal identified. It provides Shikarpur district/taluka/deh map navigation and public land-record services, but no anonymous machine-readable parcel feature response with safe native ID and geometry was found.

queries.query: سکھرپور سندھ سرکاری زمین ریکارڈ نقشہ کادستر اراضی ریکارڈ
queries.result: Discovery returned the same official Sindh Zameen / Board of Revenue portal and its multilingual public-service labels. The public map flow remains static/image and HTML navigation, without an anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry API.

registryBasis: The official Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh portal is a land-record custodian and its public map flow explicitly exposes District Shikarpur, Shikarpur taluka, 26 available dehs, and a Shikarpur Peoples Service Center. This evidences a local/provincial registry custodian, not an open parcel-geometry API.
runtimeReadinessReason: Held pending independent serial qualification of a real public parcel adapter. This packet is not source integration or admission.
